turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello! How's everything today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty relaxed today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to meal prep lunches for the week. Cheap and not boring, please.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure. Do you want one big batch of the same thing, like a chili, or two smaller recipes you can alternate?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, good question.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No rush, it really depends on how much variety you need.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, no rush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, all done here, back to the game.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Finally!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ben, are we out of dish soap?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Almost. There's maybe one more load in the bottle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, adding it to the list. Anything else you need from the store?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oat milk, and those crackers I like.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The rosemary ones?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yes, those. Get two boxes if they're on sale.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, all done. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Did you decide between one batch and two alternating recipes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two, I'd get sick of chili by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. How about a lentil curry and a pasta salad, both keep well for four days.
